sourceCaption:
Breaking: Jaxson Dart is expected to have knee surgery that will lead to a full recovery, but end his 2026 season, sources told @rapsheet and @mike_garafolo.

Dart suffered damage to his MCL, PCL and meniscus with the meniscus being the main issue, sources tell @adamschefter.
